description: This file contains functions and types for configuring provider onboarding, including model aliasing, applying default models, merging models, and handling provider configurations within the OpenClaw system.

methods.name: extractAgentDefaultModelFallbacks
methods.description: Extracts fallback models from a given model object if present.

methods.name: normalizeAgentModelAliasEntry
methods.description: Normalizes an agent model alias entry, converting string entries to objects.

methods.name: applyOnboardAuthAgentModelsAndProviders
methods.description: Applies agent models and provider configurations to the main configuration object.

methods.name: applyAgentDefaultModelPrimary
methods.description: Sets the primary default model in the configuration, preserving fallbacks if present.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModels
methods.description: Merges default models into a provider configuration, handling existing models.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModel
methods.description: Wraps default model into provider configuration.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithDefaultModelPreset
methods.description: Applies a preset configuration with default model and optional aliases and primary model reference.

methods.name: createProviderPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates functions to apply provider presets based on resolved parameters.

methods.name: createDefaultModelPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates functions to apply default model presets.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithModelCatalog
methods.description: Merges catalog models into provider configuration, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithModelCatalogPreset
methods.description: Applies catalog models preset with optional primary model reference.

methods.name: createModelCatalogPresetAppliers
methods.description: Creates functions to apply model catalog presets.

methods.name: resolveProviderModelMergeState
methods.description: Resolves the current state of provider models for merging, including existing provider and models.

methods.name: applyProviderConfigWithMergedModels
methods.description: Applies merged models to the provider configuration, updating the provider list.

methods.name: buildProviderConfig
methods.description: Constructs a provider configuration object, normalizing API keys and setting models.
